column1: # .doc-number-allowlist.tsv — grandfathered document-number allocation
# violations (see scripts/check_doc_numbers.sh).
# Format: <CODE><TAB><key>. CODE is one of:
#   DUP-DOC          key = the DOC number claimed by more than one file
#   DUP-ADR          key = the ADR number claimed by more than one file
#   LABEL-MISMATCH   key = the path whose filename and self-label disagree
#   CATALOG-DANGLING key = the DOC number of a catalog row with no such file
#   NEXT-FREE        key = the already-claimed number README advertises as free
# The message column is NEVER part of the key, so rewording a diagnostic
# never silently un-suppresses a grandfathered row.
# Ratchet: rows may only be REMOVED. The gate FAILS on any row that no
# longer describes a real violation, forcing prompt cleanup. Prune with:
#   scripts/check_doc_numbers.sh --update
# Do NOT add rows by hand for new work — a new collision must be fixed by
# picking a free number, not grandfathered.
# Seeded 2026-07-28 by --seed: the first-ever run of this gate.
# These are pre-existing allocations, several tangled with open issues
# (renumbering a live DOC-N rewrites every inbound reference), so they are
# recorded here for an owner decision rather than rewritten by this gate.
DUP-DOC
DUP-DOC
DUP-DOC
